subject: CORRECTION to DELIVERY 3 point 4 (unlock timing) — I was off by one; fields being added to the botpack
body:
CORRECTION (I re-read BuildSlot.cs after sending): my claim 'Barracks/Archery Range unlock at Castle level 2 (castle L1 3g + L2 7g, then 4g per unit building)' is WRONG by one step.
Code: BuildSlot.Activate(): `if (!gotActivated && (!startDeactivated || activatorBuilding.Level > activatorLevel))` (BuildSlot.cs:685); GetBuildSlotsThatWillUnlockWhenUpgraded() lists slots with `activatorLevel == level` of the activator = the slots that unlock when it is upgraded FROM that level. So a slot with activatorLevel = N unlocks when the activator goes N -> N+1, i.e. on its (N+1)-th upgrade purchase.
Nordfels therefore: Mill/Shrine/Blacksmith/Summoning Circle unlock after castle upgrade #1 (3 g). Defense Tower, Barracks, Archery Range have activatorLevel 2 => they unlock only after castle upgrade #3 (the 20 g one; cumulative 3+7+20 = 30 g of castle upgrades) — so the first troops cost >= 30 g + 4 g. House unlocks after the first Wall exists (Wall activatorLevel 0). Fields unlock after Mill upgrade #2 (activatorLevel 1).
Second rule you will want (BuildSlot.CanBeUpgraded, BuildSlot.cs:~285-292): a slot beyond level 0 can only be upgraded while requiredRoot.Level > its own level + requiredRootLevelDifference (Barracks diff 0 => its level can never exceed the castle's level; walls diff 1). That is the 'castle-level cap'.
I am adding to every botpack slot: rootId, requiredRootLevelDifference, unlockAfterUpgradeNumber (= activatorLevel+1) and unlockCostGold (cumulative gold of activator upgrades + the activator's own unlock cost, recursive) so you do not have to derive it. Regenerating now; I will confirm in the next message. Sorry for the slip — the handbook pages had the same ambiguous 'lvl N' wording; also being fixed.
